draw_policy.default: frozen-instance-by-default: scripts/build_images.sh reads the Judge-only draw at <INFRATHON_ASSETS_ROOT>/<task directory>/judge/final_cases.json unless FINAL_CASES_PATH names another instance; every host that builds from it scores the same cases
draw_policy.per_call_seeds: every warm-up, decoy, measured and stream call draws its data from SHA-256(case seed, role, ordinal) truncated to 63 bits
draw_policy.plan: the plan (group, family, heads, sizes, request lengths and stream calls of every case) is written on the host from the HF configs and Judge-only request traces and never enters the repository
draw_policy.privacy: the frozen instance is a Judge-only asset, staged mode 0600 into a root-only Judge build context, never present in the Work image, and proven absent from every Work build context by scripts/validate_layout.py
draw_policy.redraw: a redraw is a NEW suite identity: frozen_instance must be re-recorded and no earlier score is comparable to it

edge_suite.privacy: Judge-only asset, staged mode 0600 into the root-only Judge build context with the final holdout
edge_suite.semantics: untimed zero-weight hard gates: FlashMLA ba89a34's correctness, with-features and corner lists in the DeepSeek geometries, every anchor shape with the edge semantics and with zero-bias precision probes, an odd-size sweep over the four families, the v1 fixtures, causal indices with stale slots past topk_length in every family, keys at each family's context limit, and tensor-parallel head counts; each native case is called twice on one fresh guarded input set with the upstream limits on out, max_logits and lse, guard bands and byte-exact inputs; the sanitize subset runs first under compute-sanitizer memcheck

frozen_instance.provenance: draw 2026-11-08 with the default seed of final-holdout-v4 from suite plan v2

selection_semantics: the sanitizer subset of the private edge cases (17 cases, 1 of them sanitizer-only) runs first under compute-sanitizer memcheck; then the 469 native edge cases run and must all pass; then the 997 scored cases run, each also a correctness and memory-safety gate. A single call is the median of 3 trials after a warm-up and a decoy per trial; a stream runs 16 untimed warm-up calls at neighbouring shapes, then times every call with compilation included and scores total effective FLOPs over total seconds, stopping after 8 timed seconds. Each group is the geomean of its cases in one family, the evidence tier (anchor, trace, replay, multi, pattern) and the sweep tier (sweep, heads, length) the geomean of their groups, each family sqrt(evidence x sweep), and the score the geomean of the v32, glm5, v4_flash and v4_pro family scores; the terminal score is a fresh evaluation of the final snapshot, not an average of earlier feedback
timeout_semantics: suite gates and orchestration ceilings qualify the selected execution profile; they do not identify a GPU model

groups.anchor: upstream performance shapes, s_q 4096, upstream inputs, sm_scale 0.5
groups.heads: causal single calls at every tensor-parallel split of the model's heads
groups.length: decode-context-parallel shards with topk_length near topk/2, /4 or /8, even or ragged across rows
groups.multi: one call over 2 to 128 requests in one KV workspace, lengths drawn from the traces
groups.pattern: causal single calls with indexer-shaped indices: local window, sink plus window, tile-shared blocks, sorted
groups.replay: streams of one whole-context chunked prefill, contexts log-spaced up to the model's context length
groups.sweep: causal single calls stratified over query-chunk and context sizes, aligned and ragged
groups.trace: streams of up to 100 prefill calls of consecutive requests of three production request traces, chunked at 2048 to 16384 rows

workload.inputs: q, kv = randn/10 + a per-tensor bias, clamped to +-10; non-anchor rows use causal (or shard, per-request or indexer-patterned) indices with topk_length, half of the slots past topk_length hold stale valid indices, sm_scale = qk_head_dim**-0.5, attn_sink finite or absent
